description.zh: 结束时间。需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 > 不填默认查询从StartTime起一小时内的数据。
description.en:
The end time. It must be later than the start time. The format is *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z (UTC).

> If you do not specify this parameter, data within one hour of the start time is queried by default.

title.zh: 获取域名1分钟粒度带宽数据

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口查询指定域名的流量和带宽使用情况。
- 可以查询最近7天内的数据，单次查询StartTime和EndTime跨度不能超过24小时。
- 如果StartTime和EndTime均未指定，默认返回当前时间起1小时内的数据。
- 本接口为监控数据接口，数据采集处理方式不同于计费，不能用于计算用量进行对账参考。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to query the traffic and bandwidth usage of a specified domain name.

- You can query data from the last 7 days. The time range of a single query cannot exceed 24 hours.

- If you do not specify StartTime and EndTime, data for the last hour is returned by default.

- This operation provides monitoring data. The data collection and processing methods are different from those used for billing. You cannot use the data from this operation for billing reconciliation.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10. If you exceed this limit, your API calls are throttled. This may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-domain-real-time-bps-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example1.aliyundoc.com,example2.aliyundoc.com --isp-name-en alibaba --location-name-en tianjin --start-time 2015-11-30T05:39:00Z --end-time 2015-11-30T05:40:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveDomainRealTimeBpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn alibaba --EndTime '2015-11-30T05:40:00Z' --DomainName 'example1.aliyundoc.com,example2.aliyundoc.com' --LocationNameEn tianjin --StartTime '2015-11-30T05:39:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
